description: PyTrainSim provides a Python agent-based and discrete-event train simulation for railway delay propagation. The provider is PyTrainSim project. Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository supports fixed-block and moving-block signalling with TOML scenario settings. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support railway delay propagation and signalling scenario comparison. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
